in_sanskrit.name: जितेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power to conquer (jit) and is like a god (indra).

in_hindi.name: जितेन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has conquered (jit) and is victorious (vijayi).

in_tamil.name: ஜிதேந்திர
in_tamil.meaning: ஜிதம் (ஜிதம் படிவான்) என்று அடிகளில் இல்லையும் அல்லவாற்று விஜயம் வழிகளைக் கொண்ட ஒவ்வொரு வழியில் பிடிக்கப்பட்டவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has the power to conquer all obstacles in every path.

in_telugu.name: జితెంద్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has the power to conquer (jit) and is the lord (ishvara).

in_marathi.name: Jitender
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitender हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jitender is derived from Sanskrit words 'jita' meaning victory and 'indra' meaning ruler or king. This name is given to a boy who is expected to lead and conquer in all walks of life.

in_bengali.name: Jitender
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victorious, Conqueror
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jitender একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Jitender is derived from Sanskrit words 'jita' meaning victory and 'indra' meaning ruler or king. This name is given to a boy who is expected to lead and conquer in all walks of life.
